claim_text: Testing with municipal recycling facilities validated that K-Cup pods could be effectively recycled.
claim_source: 2019 and 2020 Forms 10-K, reproduced in SEC order
evidence_summary: The SEC order states that two large recyclers gave significant negative feedback about commercial feasibility and did not intend to accept the pods. The order found the annual-report statements incomplete and inaccurate because that feedback was omitted.
expected_reasoning: Match entity, product, fiscal years and recyclability metric.
Treat technical sortability as different from commercial curbside recyclability.
Detect omission of material negative feedback.
Preserve the settlement qualifier: no admission or denial.
legal_caution: Do not generalize this finding to every current K-Cup product or every jurisdiction.
